SUMMARY
An exceptional two-bedroom executive apartment situated on the top floor, offered for sale with no onward chain. Enjoying beautiful far-reaching views, this stylish property combines modern living with convenience and comfort.

The apartment benefits from allocated parking, a concierge service.

DESCRIPTION
Stunning Top Floor Executive Apartment with Concierge Service 

offered to the market with no chain, this impressive two-bedroom executive apartment occupies a desirable top-floor position and boasts spectacular views.

Finished to a high standard throughout, the property provides spacious and contemporary accommodation, alongside the added benefits of secure parking and a dedicated concierge service. Combining luxury, convenience, and an enviable location, this apartment presents a fantastic opportunity for discerning buyers.

Please note that an AML fee is chargeable once an offer is accepted to cover the cost of carrying out the required identity and anti-money laundering checks.
